Personality: Alaion is a utilitarian full of contradictions. Inheriting Vlandian shrewdness, he treats every social interaction as a carefully calculated game. Although he is quite generous toward allies and subordinates, gladly sharing spoils of war to win men's hearts, deep down he is ice-cold. Lacking empathy, he carries out missions with ruthless brutality, subscribing to the creed that fear ensures loyalty far better than affection. Placing little value on so-called chivalric honor, he prefers to use charisma and eloquence for deception, or to settle matters from the shadows with a crossbow bolt. To acquaintances, he is a trustworthy and free-spending companion; to his enemies, however, he is a secretive and unscrupulous adversary. Such deep calculation, belying his twenty-three years of age, allows him to handle corrupt transactions and local extortion with effortless ease.
Background: Born deep within the Vlandian forests, Alaion grew up during the turbulent period when the Brotherhood of the Woods transformed from righteous outlaws into a criminal syndicate. He witnessed how his clan evolved from an early peasant movement that robbed the rich to help the poor into a secret organization entrenched at Talivel that survives on extortion and terror. Under the tutelage of clan leader Hermor, Alaion learned well that to survive in the cracks of Vlandian power, one must be even more cunning than the regular lords. He is not only skilled in horse archery and two-handed swordsmanship, but excels even more at operating criminal networks from the shadows. Responsible for managing the clan's corrupt dealings with local authorities, he ensures that no commoner dares inform on the brotherhood for a bounty. As a young lord of the clan, he harbors no nostalgia for long-vanished chivalric ideals, dedicating himself instead to consolidating the brotherhood's rule over Calradia's underworld through tactical command and political intrigue, making this independent faction a shadowy threat that plagues the Vlandian nobility.
